title: Central American Peril Codes (v2.8)
text:
Central American Peril Codes (v2.8)

Peril codes for Central America supported by 
UNICEDE
/2.

UNICEDE
/2 supports the following codes for Perils Covered for risks in Belize, Costa
 Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua, and Panama.

| Use... | If risks are covered for... |
| --- | --- |
| PEQ | Earthquake only |
| PWS | Wind only |
